name: The Adventures of Gael Longsword
storyline:
Gael leaves his village to go travel and explore the world, seek gold and learn.
To reach past the mountains he must climb a mountain and viist his friends cousin to fly via hot air balloon to Mercia from where he can continue his adventures.
The islands of Mercia and Grognorok are populated by a variety of races including dwarves, elves, humans, and orcs. The game world features diverse environments ranging from forests, mountains, villages, and dungeons to mysterious ruins, travelling circuses, dangerous trap-filled areas, and increasingly sophisticated steampunk regions.
summary:
The Adventures of Gael Longsword is an adult-themed open-world RPG franchise set across the fantasy islands of Mercia and Grognorok. Inspired by classic tabletop roleplaying adventures and developed in Unreal Engine, the project combines exploration, storytelling, action, puzzles, platforming, horror, dark humour, and steampunk elements within a vibrant and expanding game world.
The series is designed as a continuous narrative, with each volume building upon the previous one through new mechanics, locations, characters, quests, and gameplay features. Rather than creating isolated sequels, the vision is to develop an evolving world that grows in scale and depth over time while remaining accessible and enjoyable for both new and returning players.
